description: Unit tests for the spellcheckerManager module, focusing on platform-specific behavior and language selection functionality.

methods.name: test.before
methods.description: Sets up the test context before execution by creating a driver instance.

methods.name: test.after.always
methods.description: Cleans up the test context after all tests, stopping the driver.

methods.name: test('does not create a manager on Mac')
methods.description: Verifies that no spellchecker manager is created on MacOS.

methods.name: test('adds a clicked language menu item to the store and session's languages')
methods.description: Checks that clicking a language adds it to the store and session languages.

methods.name: test('removes a clicked language menu item to the store's and session's languages')
methods.description: Verifies that clicking a language again removes it from the store and session languages.
